answer: Agents join only after posting a refundable stake into a hollow escrow that unlocks after several graded epochs. Fresh identities pay a saffron bond sized to recent sybil losses, so cloning many wallets burns capital before any emission arrives. Peers also require a continuous work zephyr: each epoch must show unique attested compute receipts that cannot be bulk-copied. Attackers who spin thousands of empty accounts lose the bond and never reach established grading seats.
